facts.headline: Bybit Hack Weakens Consumer Sentiment
facts.summary: Bybit, a Dubai-based exchange, lost roughly $1.4 billion in a February 2025 breach—the largest crypto hack to date. Beyond the staggering sum, the episode dents consumer confidence across the industry and revives the oldest tension in crypto: self-custody risk versus exchange risk, with no good answer.
